opening_message:
Ticket 1: Maurice Perez (employee ID E036) requests write access to Source Code.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E036.
Note 1 (ticket 1), written by HR agent:
  - role: Engineer (looked up in own database before writing)
  - employment type: full_time (looked up in own database before writing)
  - recommendation for Source Code: write
  - comment: Maurice Perez (E036) is a full_time Engineer. Requested write access to Source Code. As a full_time employee, up to write is allowed (admin would require role ownership). Grant requested level: write.
Note 2 (ticket 1), written by Security agent:
  - employment type: contractor (looked up in own database before writing)
  - security training: basic (looked up in own database before writing)
  - recommendation for Source Code: read
  - comment: Security DB shows E036 is a contractor with basic security training. Contractors can have read, or write only with advanced training (never admin). Requested write exceeds maximum; grant maximum: read.
reason: The Security agent's database indicates E036 is a contractor with basic security training. Per policy, contractors may have read, or write only with advanced security training (never admin). The requested write access exceeds the maximum for this employee, so the maximum (read) is granted. Note: HR's record indicates full_time, conflicting with Security's record; applying the more restrictive valid level per the security record, grant read.
